title: Azure Bastion - Simply Explained
description:
Every VM with a public IP and an open RDP port is a target, and jump boxes add their own patching burden. This episode explains Azure Bastion for Azure admins and cloud architects: how it works, what the Entra ID integration adds and which SKU fits your budget. You will know how to remove public IPs and move to identity-based VM access.
In this episode
00:00 – Why open RDP ports are a problem00:47 – The old way: jump boxes and public RDP02:22 – What Azure Bastion is03:43 – How Azure Bastion works05:04 – Entra ID authentication for VM logins06:58 – SKUs, pricing and the real cost of jump boxes08:38 – The big picture09:57 – Getting started with Bastion
Key takeaways
Azure Bastion is a fully managed service that gives secure RDP and SSH access to Azure VMs over HTTPS, so the VMs need no public IP and no exposed management ports.Native Entra ID authentication brings MFA, Conditional Access and Azure RBAC roles to VM logins and removes the need for local accounts and passwords on each machine.Choose the Standard or Premium SKU for production, deploy into a dedicated AzureBastionSubnet, remove public IPs and restrict NSGs to the Bastion subnet, starting with your most critical VMs.
Worth quoting
“Here's the thing, every exposed port is a target, and ransomware gangs scan for open RDP constantly.” – Mirko Peters (00:24)
“The problem isn't that it can't work. It's that it takes constant work to keep it safe.” – Mirko Peters (01:36)
Explore more on M365.FM
